title.en: The Tractor 4100 Order Includes the Printed Slump Cell
title.zh: 拖拉机带动4100的订单包含印出的坍落度格

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Tractor-Driven 4100 at 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h and concrete slump 180–220 mm. That slump cell is part of this page’s order, not a general rule for every pump.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把拖拉机带动4100印成 40 kW、6–12 m³/h、混凝土坍落度 180–220 mm。这个坍落度格属于这一页的订单，不是每台泵的通用规则。

h1.en: Order the Tractor Page Only with Its Own Cells
h1.zh: 只按拖拉机页自己的格子下单

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Tractor-Driven 4100 as 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 15 MPa, 40–100 m / 15–45 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, hopper 0.25 m³, slump 180–220 mm, 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm and 1300 kg. The order is this tractor-driven page, not a 4105 diesel trailer and not Diesel 40. Other pump sheets used here do not print this slump line, so do not copy 180–220 mm onto them. Send the path to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/) when the drive matches this sheet. No price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）把拖拉机带动4100印成 40 kW、6–12 m³/h、15 MPa、40–100 m / 15–45 m、骨料 1–3 cm、料斗 0.25 m³、坍落度 180–220 mm、2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm、1300 kg。订单是这张拖拉机带动页，不是 4105 柴油拖泵，也不是柴油40。此处使用的其他泵页不印这行坍落度，所以不要把 180–220 mm 抄过去。驱动方式与这张表相符时，把路径发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。没有印价格。

body.en: Output is 6–12 m³/h. Horizontal is 40–100 m. Vertical is 15–45 m. Do not pick one end and drop the other.
body.zh: 输送量是 6–12 m³/h。水平是 40–100 m。垂直是 15–45 m。不要只留一端。

heading.en: 1300 kg is not the rural pump

body.en: The rural diesel prints 800 kg, 17 kW and 5–8 m³/h. The tractor page is heavier and lists slump.
body.zh: 农村柴油泵印 800 kg、17 kW、5–8 m³/h。拖拉机页更重，并且列出坍落度。

body.en: 4105 / 56 kW is Diesel 30. Writing 4105 on a tractor order mixes two paths.
body.zh: 4105 / 56 kW 是柴油30。在拖拉机订单上写 4105 会把两条路径混在一起。

answer.en: Not on the Electric 20 list used here.
answer.zh: 此处使用的电动20列表上没有。

alt.zh: 拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵，由河北品锦机械厂家制造，邢台
